# Musclog

> Musclog is a free, open-source, local-first fitness and nutrition tracker for Android, iOS, and web. It logs workouts, tracks macros with AI photo/barcode meal recognition, and charts progress — all with data stored privately on-device rather than in the cloud.

Musclog is built and maintained in the open; the full source is on GitHub. This file summarizes the public marketing site at https://musclog.app for AI assistants and agents — for the product itself, see the Download and FAQ pages below.

## Product

- [Home](https://musclog.app/): Overview of Musclog — workout logging, AI meal tracking, progress analytics, and on-device privacy.
- [Download](https://musclog.app/download): Get Musclog for Android (Play Store) or join the iOS TestFlight.
- [Exercise Library](https://musclog.app/exercises): Browse exercises by muscle group, equipment, and mechanic type, with instructions and visuals.
- [Fitness & Macro Calculator](https://musclog.app/calculator): Estimate calories, macros, BMI, and FFMI, usable standalone or as a starting plan in the app.
- [Progress Import](https://musclog.app/progress): Import a Musclog JSON export in-browser to explore weight, nutrition, workout, mood, and measurement trends.
- [Musclog vs. Alternatives](https://musclog.app/alternatives): Honest comparison of Musclog against MyFitnessPal, MacroFactor, Cronometer, Bevel, Lifesum, Hevy, and other fitness/nutrition apps.
- [Lifting Tools](https://musclog.app/tools): Free calculators for lifters: one-rep max, plates, warm-ups, RPE, protein, calorie deficit and net carbs.
- [One-Rep Max Calculator](https://musclog.app/tools/one-rep-max): Estimate your one-rep max from a set, with reps in reserve and a percentage-of-1RM table.
- [Plate Calculator](https://musclog.app/tools/plate-calculator): Find the plates to load on each side of the bar from the plates your gym actually has.
- [Strength Level Checker](https://musclog.app/tools/strength-level): See which strength level a lift is at for your body weight, shown as a range, never a percentile.
- [Warm-Up Set Calculator](https://musclog.app/tools/warm-up-calculator): Warm-up sets for a working weight, each one loadable with your plates.
- [RPE and RIR Chart](https://musclog.app/tools/rpe-chart): An RPE and reps-in-reserve chart with a load calculator built on the same math as the app.
- [Protein Calculator](https://musclog.app/tools/protein-calculator): Daily protein in grams per kilogram of body weight, by goal, from the same rules the app uses.
- [Calorie Deficit Calculator](https://musclog.app/tools/calorie-deficit): Daily calories for a goal weight and date, with an honest range instead of a single promise.
- [Net Carbs vs Total Carbs](https://musclog.app/tools/net-carbs): Convert between net and total carbs and see why US and EU food labels disagree.
- [Free Workout Programs](https://musclog.app/programs): Free workout programs with every day, exercise, set and rep, that you can open in Musclog.
- [Musclog vs Strong](https://musclog.app/alternatives/strong): Honest comparison of Musclog and Strong: free routine limit, PRO pricing and importing your Strong history.
- [Musclog vs Hevy](https://musclog.app/alternatives/hevy): Honest comparison of Musclog and Hevy: free plan limits, the warm-up calculator and importing your Hevy history.
- [Musclog vs MyFitnessPal](https://musclog.app/alternatives/myfitnesspal): Honest comparison of Musclog and MyFitnessPal: barcode scanning and what the free version includes.

## Support & Policies

- [FAQ](https://musclog.app/faq): Answers about privacy, nutrition math, workout tracking, AI features, and the app's open-source methodology.
- [Contact](https://musclog.app/contact): How to reach Musclog for support, bug reports, or open-source collaboration.
- [Privacy Policy](https://musclog.app/privacy): How Musclog handles app data, website analytics, optional AI providers, local-first storage, and encryption.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://musclog.app/terms): Terms of use, service scope, liability, and governing law.

## Source & Extras

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/blopa/musclog-app): Full source code, issues, and license (open-source).
- [Blog](https://musclog.app/blog): Articles about Musclog, open-source development, privacy, fitness technology, and the ideas behind the app.
- [Blog categories](https://musclog.app/blog/category): Every category of the Musclog blog, with the number of articles in each.
- [Blog tags](https://musclog.app/blog/tag): Every tag used on the Musclog blog as a cloud, sized by how many articles carry it.
- [Rep Marker Tool](https://musclog.app/rep-marker): Browser tool for uploading and labeling rep-counting training data.
- [Game Boy Edition](https://musclog.app/gameboy): A Game Boy Color version of Musclog, playable in-browser.
